note: The source workbook carries four header rows: row 1 the survey Q-code (Q20_1..Q20_14), row 2 the original scale item number (Schutte_1, Schutte_2, Schutte_7, ...), row 3 the domain, row 4 the literal item text. The IRW code schutte_N is a case-lowered copy of row 2, so code-to-text is tied at the source with no inference (data_labels); data/dpt_noncognitive_traits.py only lowercases the row-2 labels. Corroborated independently: all 14 wordings match canonical Schutte et al. (1998) SSEIT numbering exactly, and the paper's EFA table reproduces 6 of the 14 wordings verbatim (including the sole reverse-worded item, schutte_33, loading -0.440). Item text transcribed literally including two source typos (schutte_2 'I faces', schutte_13 'events other enjoy'). Anchors 1=strongly disagree / 5=strongly agree taken from the paper's own description of the SSEIT administration; midpoints unlabelled, left blank. No quotable non-commercial, redistribution or fee restriction was found for the SSEIT; the deposit is CC0 and the article CC BY, so no wording_rights flag is set.
